{name}, can you hear me? The Throne has been empty for a hundred years — and today the Abyss has risen to the very clouds.
Where am I?.. I only remember light and a voice calling my name.
You are the last one touched by the light of the Throne. As long as you live, the Heavens have a defender.
Another hero? The Abyss has swallowed better than you. The valley will be the first to fall.
Don't listen to him. Gather a squad — together we will return the light to the Throne.
The Slime King is only my first servant. Let's see how you handle him.
The thicket is sick. The roots whisper of a darkness drinking their sap.
We will find the source, my Lady.
Then take him with you. The Moon Wolf has lost his pack — now you are his pack.
Your pet will be at your side in every battle. Feed him — and he will grow stronger along with your squad.
The wastes burn, yet my forges have gone cold. The Abyss has stolen fire from the flame itself!
Then we will bring it back, Emperor.
Hm. In the ruins of the forge lie wings forged for a hero of the Throne. Too small for me — take them.
The Wings of Dawn! They remember the first defender of the Heavens. Feathers will make them stronger.
Hush... The grottoes are listening. The sea serpent Irr has gone mad from the whispers of the Abyss.
Take this tear. The Leviathan shed it when the Throne fell. Ancient things hold the power of whole ages.
This is an artifact. Let your squad carry artifacts — and every warrior will grow sturdier.
You came just in time, guardian. The temple keeps a secret: the Throne is locked with seven keys.
And the Abyss is looking for them?
It has already found three. The Obelisk Guardian protects the fourth — don't let it fall.
The keys will come to me on their own. Just like your soul, hero.
Here, in the ice, sleeps the forge of the gods. The divine gear of the first guardians came from it.
Does the Hoarfrost Dragon guard it?
He is its flame. Defeat him — and the forge will wake. Heroes from level 150 will be able to wield divine blades and aegises.
What a guest... A hero of the Throne in my city. Want an alliance? I don't care for the Abyss either.
Why should I trust the Queen of the Night?
Because the Shadow Regent is an enemy to us both. And after that... we'll see.
Be careful. Lilith always has two faces.
The gardens are withering. Perhaps the Heavens deserved to fall, since they failed to protect the Throne?
The Heavens are not a throne. They are those who rise when the throne is empty.
...You speak like the first guardian. Then I will take up my trumpet again and call the angels.
You have reached the edge, brother in light. I too once stood here — and took a step down.
Azael... Do you serve the Abyss?
I serve the truth. The Devourer of Stars holds the keys. Defeat him — and you will learn who really sat on the Throne.
Have you come to take my place, guardian?
Yours? You gave the Throne to the Abyss!
I protected it for a thousand years until I understood: the Abyss is the hunger of the Heavens themselves. The ancient gear of the first ages awaits the one who accepts this.
Don't listen! But he is right about one thing: the ancient armor has awakened. It will accept only heroes from level 300.
Show me what your faith is worth!
The Throne trembled, and the Primordials awoke — legends older than the Heavens and the Abyss.
Child of the Throne. The earth remembers your steps. Help it — and I will help you.
Gaia. Mother of all that grows. The marshes are rotting — find their Mistress and return their sleep.
My fire will end this world when the time comes. But not today — and not by the will of the Abyss.
Surtur... even I bow my head before the Last Fire.
Defeat my smith — and I will think about it.
The islands fall into the sea one after another. The Abyss drags them to the bottom.
Strong waves are born in the deep, child. The Warden of the Winds has gone mad — calm him.
The sun will set over the sands for the last time if the pharaoh awakens his army.
Helios! We thought you had faded.
Light does not fade — it waits. Let the hero's arrows become my rays.
The caves are singing. Every crystal is a frozen memory of the Throne.
I hear a voice... Was that me?
It was the first guardian. Your soul is older than you think.
My tree is stricken. If it falls, the world will forget how to grow.
My Lady, the forest will give you all its roots!
Remember our deal, hero? Time to pay. The Crimson Lord is my old debt.
Then he will come for you himself. Choice is an illusion, darling.
I am the Voice of the Throne. I record every word of the Heavens.
Then tell me: who should sit on the Throne?
The one who can refuse it. The Stargazer of the Abyss knows the answer — he stole my scrolls.
Before light there was night. Before the Throne there was me.
Nyx... mother of darkness. Even the Abyss fears her.
The Abyss is my disobedient child. My shadow got lost in the halls. Bring it back — and the night will be on your side.
You have gathered the legends, hero. But the Heart of the Abyss beats at the very Gates!
This is the last battle of the age. Beyond it — the Throne.
The Heart of the Abyss cannot be stopped!
The Heart of the Abyss is broken, but the echo of its beats has returned to the old lands.
Then we will walk them again. Only now we are stronger.
Darkness has returned to the thicket — more cunning than before. It hides in the roots.
Luna smells it. Lead the way!
The forges burn again! Surtur returned our fire — it's time to forge weapons for the last war.
Irr has returned from the depths... but he is no longer himself. The Abyss wears his shape.
Free him, child. The sea will repay you.
The sun rose in the west. It's a trick of the Abyss — it forged the dawn!
No one can forge my light. Shoot, hero, I will guide the arrow.
The forge of the gods is freezing. Without it divine gear will fade.
Then we will light it again.
Forgive me, hero. The Abyss offered me more.
I warned you: the queen has two faces.
Then I will keep both eyes open.
The angels sing again! Your path has given them back their voice.
The Throne is waiting, guardian. But first — the White Serpent, the last guardian of the gardens.
Below lies the underside of the world. That is where the Abyss hides the seventh key.
I will go first. I have fallen there once before.
You have walked the whole path. Now sit — or refuse, as Metatron said.
I will not sit on the Throne. I will stand beside it — and be its shield.
This is the answer I have waited a thousand years for. From now on you are the Zenith of the Heavens.

«Celestial Throne» does not collect, share or sell personal data. No account is needed.

Game progress (heroes, resources, settings) and the hero name you entered yourself are stored only on your device — in the app's local storage. A save code is created only on your command and copied manually.
The game works offline. There are no analytics, ads or third-party trackers.

In the current version gold purchases work in test mode, no money is charged. If real purchases appear later, Google Play or the App Store will process them under their own rules; card data is never passed to the game.
The game is not designed to collect children's data and does not collect it.
The developer's contact is listed on the app's store page.
The game is provided «as is» for entertainment. In-game resources, heroes and skins have no monetary value and cannot be exchanged for money.

Heroes in summons drop at random. Odds by rarity are shown on every banner and in the Wheel of Heavens; guarantees are tracked by counters on the same screens. The history of the last 100 heroes is in the «Summon» section.
In this version the arena, guilds and clan wars are played against computer opponents.
Progress is stored on the device. Make a copy with a save code before changing phones.
